scenarios.name: Open a workspace panel from the dock tab bar

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
Model is docked and Log is closed
the user clicks the plus button in the Model dock tab bar
the panel menu offers Log Panel, Favorites, Material Browser and Appearance Browser
the user chooses Log Panel from that menu
Log is available beside Model in the same dock tab bar
the user selects Log and closes its dock tab
Log is removed from the tab bar
Model is still available in the same dock region
